metadata.name: rat
metadata.description: Rat — multiplayer bluffing card game on Solana with Pedersen commitments

instructions.name: abandon_game
docs: Abandon a stale game. Permissionless — anyone can call after 1 hour of
inactivity. Refunds entry fees to players, returns all rent to dealer.
Works in any game state.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless caller — anyone can trigger abandonment after the timeout.

types.name: PlayerAccount
docs: Player account PDA: ["player", &game_id, player.key().as_ref()]
Allocated: 2,048 bytes (2 KB). Per-player nullifier array enforces card
double-spend prevention (cross-player collision is cryptographically impossible).
NOTE: We do NOT use `#[account]` here because the derived BorshDeserialize
puts the full 2,041-byte struct on the stack (5,704-byte frame), exceeding
SBF's 4,096-byte per-frame limit. Instead we implement BorshDeserialize
manually using heap allocation, and provide the Anchor traits explicitly.
